content.text:
* OTA-WIDE-SKY130 : complementary-input folded-cascode OTA, single high-Z output node (v3)
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS

* ---------------- bias network (IBIAS = 10uA diode reference) ----------------
XMBN  IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=32 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMBN2 vbp   IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=32 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMBP  vbp   vbp   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=80 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMC1  vbnc  vbp   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=80 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMRC  vbnc  vbnc  nrc VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=32 L=1 nf=1 m=1
R1    nrc   VSS   13k
XMC2  vbpc  IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=32 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMRP  vbpc  vbpc  nrp VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=80 L=1 nf=1 m=1
R2    VDD   nrp   13k
* low-density tail bias diodes
XMTFN vtn   vbp   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=40 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMTDN vtn   vtn   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=32 L=0.25 nf=1 m=1
XMTFP vtp   IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=32 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMTDP vtp   vtp   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.25 nf=1 m=1

* ---------------- N-pair half (PMOS folded, NMOS wide-swing mirror) ----------------
XMNT  tn    vtn   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=64 L=0.25 nf=1 m=2
XMN1  na    VINP  tn  VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=60 L=0.25 nf=1 m=3
XMN2  nb    VINN  tn  VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=60 L=0.25 nf=1 m=3
XMPS1 na    vbp   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=80 L=1 nf=1 m=2
XMPS2 nb    vbp   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=80 L=1 nf=1 m=2
XMPC1 nc    vbpc  na  VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=80 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMPC2 VOUT  vbpc  nb  VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=80 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMNC1 nc    vbnc  nd1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=32 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMNC2 VOUT  vbnc  nd2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=32 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMNM1 nd1   nc    VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=32 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMNM2 nd2   nc    VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=32 L=1 nf=1 m=1

* ---------------- P-pair half (NMOS folded, PMOS wide-swing mirror) ----------------
XMPT  tp    vtp   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=100 L=0.25 nf=1 m=2
XMP1  pd    VINP  tp  VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=60 L=0.25 nf=1 m=6
XMP2  pe    VINN  tp  VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=60 L=0.25 nf=1 m=6
XMNS1 pd    IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=32 L=1 nf=1 m=2
XMNS2 pe    IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=32 L=1 nf=1 m=2
XMNC3 pk    vbnc  pd  VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=32 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMNC4 VOUT  vbnc  pe  VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=32 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMPM1 pf1   pk    VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=80 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMPM2 pf2   pk    VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=80 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMPC3 pk    vbpc  pf1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=80 L=1 nf=1 m=1
XMPC4 VOUT  vbpc  pf2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 W=80 L=1 nf=1 m=1

* output damping capacitor
CX VOUT VSS 0.7p
.ends DUT
